name: list_calendars
summary: List the names of the calendars in Calendar.app. Use first to discover the exact calendar name to target when adding or querying events.

name: query_events
summary: List events across calendars in a date range (e.g. what's coming up this week). Returns each event's uid for modify_event/delete_event. Can take a few seconds with many events.

params.name: start_date
params.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive).

params.name: end_date
params.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive, whole day). Defaults to start_date (single day).

params.name: calendar
params.description: Restrict to one calendar by exact name (from list_calendars). Omit for all.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max events to return (default 25, max 100).

name: add_event
summary: Create a calendar event. STAGED; undo deletes the created event.

params.name: calendar
params.description: Exact name of the calendar to add to (from list_calendars).

params.name: title
params.description: Event title.

params.name: date
params.description: Event day, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: start_time
params.description: Start time, 24-hour HH:MM.

params.name: end_time
params.description: End time, 24-hour HH:MM; must be after start_time.

params.name: location
params.description: Optional location.

params.name: notes
params.description: Optional notes/description.

name: modify_event
summary: Reschedule an event by uid (from query_events) to exactly the supplied title/date/start_time/end_time; location and notes change only if provided. STAGED; undo restores the prior values.

params.name: calendar
params.description: Exact name of the calendar the event lives in (from query_events).

params.name: uid
params.description: Event uid from query_events.

params.name: title
params.description: New title (pass the current one unchanged if only changing the time).

params.name: date
params.description: New day, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: start_time
params.description: New start time, 24-hour HH:MM.

params.name: end_time
params.description: New end time, 24-hour HH:MM; must be after start_time.

params.name: location
params.description: If given, replaces the location; if omitted, left unchanged.

params.name: notes
params.description: If given, replaces the notes; if omitted, left unchanged.

name: delete_event
summary: Delete an event by uid (from query_events). STAGED; undo re-creates it from details captured before deletion.

params.name: calendar
params.description: Exact name of the calendar the event lives in (from query_events).

params.name: uid
params.description: Event uid from query_events.
